name: dataflow
description: Visual data flows: core (TS engine) and server (Bun: api, supervisor, workers). POC_v0/ is the proof of concept, kept for reference.

scripts.test: bun test --cwd=dataflow.core && bun test --cwd=dataflow.server && bun test --cwd=dataflow.editor
